# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_WEIGHTED_AVERAGE_PRICE_RECLAIM_AFTER_GAP_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-09-07  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a gap up that fails to hold (price fills the gap within 30 min), a reclaim of VWAP with a bullish candle signals a fade‑to‑continuation long. This mechanism captures mean reversion following failed gap momentum, distinct from GAP_AND_GO which trades gap continuation.

## Mechanism

Define a gap up as today’s open > prior close + 0.3% of price. If price trades back to touch or cross the prior close (gap fill) within the first 30 minutes, then wait for a 5‑minute candle that closes above VWAP and is bullish (close > open) with volume > 1.5× the average volume of the prior five candles. Enter long at the close of that candle. Exit shape: Stop at the low of the gap‑fill candle; target 1.5×R. After reaching 1×R, trail stop using a Chandelier exit (ATR×1.5) for any runner. Regime filters: VIX < 25, time 9:35‑10:15, and avoid days where price stays above the 20‑period EMA for more than four consecutive 5‑minute bars (to prevent strong uptrend bias).
